title: GPUStack: attackers can run their own code
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 7 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. The severity score is critical (9.8).
rankWhy: Exploitation is confirmed by an authoritative source.

category.label: Other software

category.doThis: Find out if you use it. If you do, apply the vendor's fix.

summary: GPUStack contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated administrative access, including user and model changes, persistent administrator API-key creation, disclosure of worker and cloud-provider secrets, and code execution through POST /v2/inference-backends/from-yaml.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. CISA set Nov 12, 2026 as the deadline for US federal agencies. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
